description: Details of a GB railway station: address, managing operator, facilities, step-free access, industry codes (CRS, TIPLOC, STANOX, NLC) and, where Network Rail publishes it, the live status of each public lift. Lift status is 'In service', 'Out of service' or 'Data not available'; the last means the status is not known and the traveller should check before travelling. A station with no lifts listed is NOT a station without lifts — it may simply not report live status yet.

station.description: Station name, CRS code (KGX) or TIPLOC.
